culture.text: Loco moco is a dish featured in contemporary Hawaiian cuisine. Traditionally, loco moco consists of white rice, topped with a hamburger patty and brown gravy, and a sunny-side-up fried egg. Modern (non-traditional) presentations of the dish may include other toppings and side dishes such as grilled onions, pickled vegetables, macaroni, or potato salad.
